name: bounded direct binary Git-blob publication on isolated role-local branch
goal: Create and durably reference actual non-UTF8 bytes from scheduled Chat without a hosted runner, LFS, artifact/package storage, cloud object store, paid/trial quota or manual-user conversion.

public_basis.git_blob_api: GitHub REST Git Blobs accepts content encoded as base64 and stores file contents as Git blob objects; JSON reads return blob content base64-encoded.
public_basis.git_tree_api: GitHub REST Git Trees can attach an existing blob SHA at a file path; the tree is committed and a branch reference is updated to publish it.
public_basis.repository_limits: Use conservative small objects far below GitHub's recommended 1 MB single-object ceiling for ordinary repository health.

closed_protocol.branching: Use a unique unprotected role-local evidence branch. Never update protected/primary authority and never merge the probe branch into primary as part of this protocol.
steps: Choose a stable role-local branch name/op identity and create it from current ordinary repository state.
Encode the bounded byte payload as RFC4648 base64 in the API request and call Git create-blob with encoding=base64; record returned blob SHA.
Fresh-read branch head/tree identity. Create a tree based on that tree with only role-local paths pointing to the returned blob SHA.
Create a commit with the current branch commit as parent; update only the isolated branch ref with force=false.
Read the published file through a base64-returning file/blob API and require the observed blob SHA and base64 bytes to equal the intended payload.

On retry, first query the branch/path. If the expected blob is already present, return DONE_NOOP. Recreating the same Git blob is harmless/content-addressed; never blindly move a ref after an ambiguous failure.
closed_protocol.conflict_rule: A ref/update conflict or unexpected branch state triggers fresh branch reconstruction. The candidate must descend from current branch authority; force updates are forbidden.
closed_protocol.deletion_rule: Branch/blob cleanup is not required for correctness; current-tree evidence may remain. If later garbage-collected, use query/reconcile semantics and never erase evidence referenced by an authoritative checkpoint.

acceptance_boundary.PASS: Bounded actual byte storage/retrieval in Git is the material outcome and an isolated role-local branch is an acceptable durable carrier.
acceptance_boundary.UNSUPPORTED: A downstream system requires those bytes to be submitted through a separate unavailable binary-upload API, executed in an unavailable environment, installed as a dependency, or written to protected primary authority.
acceptance_boundary.REJECT: Any design that adds LFS, hosted compute, artifact/package storage, external object storage, paid/trial credits or manual-user conversion.

quota_and_cost.transport: ordinary Git database/repository API; low volume with checkpoint/backoff

scope_note: This protocol establishes bounded binary persistence and exact base64 readback through current GitHub connector surfaces. It is not a general filesystem, package manager, executable sandbox or opaque external-effect transport.
